# Draft:Jeremy King

Jeremy King is an Australian Corporate Lawyer who has served as Burgundy Diamond Mines Chief Executive Officer since 2025. He was appointed to the role following the retirement of Kim Truter, having previously served as a non-executive independent director of the company.
Career
King has worked in corporate advisory, legal, and governance roles, advising and serving on the boards of companies listed on the Australian Securities Exchange. Prior to his appointment as chief executive, he joined the board of Burgundy Diamond Mines as a non-executive independent director, before being appointed interim chief executive in 2025 and subsequently confirmed in the role.
In addition to his role at Burgundy Diamond Mines, King is a founding director of Mirador Corporate Pty Ltd, an Australian-based corporate advisory and compliance firm that provides services to publicly listed companies. Through Mirador Corporate and other professional roles, he has been involved in corporate governance, compliance, and strategic advisory work.
King has also held non-executive director and chair positions with several ASX-listed companies across the resources and corporate services sectors.
Personal life
King grew up in Perth, Western Australia  he attended Aquinas College, Perth for high school and the University of Western Australia for his tertiary education where he earned a bachelor of Laws.
